cuts.ofreeRecent: a night river covered with floating paper lanterns — standing; the Zhuge Liang shrine on the Wuzhang Plains plateau — holds a white feather fan upright at chest height; a cable car cabin over a misty valley — holds a tall iced coffee in a clear cup with a straw at chest height; a sunlit white marble temple — kneeling on the ground; a Guan Yu temple — standing; a desert oasis at golden hour — standing; a club powder room with a lit mirror and neon on the tiles — touches one ear cup of a pair of over-ear headphones hung around her neck; a space-station lounge bar — lights the candle inside a small red paper lantern; a penthouse window wall over the city at night — holds a cup at chest height; a castle kitchen with a great hearth — holds one end of a towel hung around her neck; a vast fantasy library of towering shelves — standing; a lantern-lit old-town street at night — standing at a waist-high railing or sill; a small bakery workroom with a floury wooden worktable and warm ovens — holds a tall iced coffee in a clear cup with a straw at chest height
